correctness.rationale: Diagonalizing the SPD quadratic H, the expected inner position recurrence is y_j=q_h y_(j−1)+eta′ gamma x_h with q_h=1−eta′(h+gamma); its unique explicit solution and exponential average mu_K yield phi_K(h)=gamma h/(h+gamma) S_K(eta′(h+gamma)). Completing the Gaussian square gives the ideal gamma h/(h+gamma). Under eta′(M+gamma)<=1, S_K(z) strictly increases, while S_K(z)/z strictly decreases for K>=2 (each polynomial geometric sum decreases, with a genuinely j>=2 term). Thus kappa∞<kappa_K<kappa=M/mu for K>=2. K=1 gives alpha gamma eta′ H and exact raw condition number; exponential averaging forgets the initialization as K→∞, and small-eta Taylor gives kappa_K→kappa at fixed K. Independent 1,000 random recurrence/filter checks with strict comparisons passed; these are finite guards only.
